numerical_stability.classification: Numerical stability policy, not hardware physical properties.
numerical_stability.derivation: 0.004 / 0.0005 = 8. A timestep-only rest experiment passed K2b at 0.0005 s while 0.004 s failed with identical physical parameters.
numerical_stability.execution: Evaluate the frozen probe controller once per 0.004 s; hold its force command over eight native physics steps. Recompute native gamepad forces and constraints at each physics step.
numerical_stability.validation_scope: Ruling 2 one-second rest passed at 0.0005 s. Ruling 3 approves production substeps; convergence and contact validation remain separate gates.
numerical_stability.uncertainty_reason: Contact accuracy and timestep convergence require the ruling 3 experiments; this is not a hardware physical property.

contact_response.classification: Numerical contact policy, not measured material properties.
contact_response.scope: Gamepad collision geoms only. The acceptance probe uses native default solref and solmix. Caller geoms and global options are unchanged.
contact_response.priority_policy: Keep native geom priority unchanged; different priorities, explicit pairs, global overrides and direct-format solref retain native precedence.
contact_response.mixing_formula: Equal priority and positive solref: tau_eff = (w_pad*tau_pad + w_other*tau_other)/(w_pad+w_other). solimp uses the same weights. Friction uses element-wise maxima independently of solmix.
contact_response.weight_derivation: For default other tau=0.02 s and w=1, relative dilution <=1e-5 requires w_pad>=899999. Choose 1000000; tau_eff=0.002000017999982 s.
contact_response.uncertainty_reason: Trial numerical response; downstream validation, convergence and full-suite results are separate evidence, not hardware contact calibration.
